items.title: Is Qualcomm Stock As Cheap As It Looks Now?
items.summary: If you have watched Qualcomm this year, the worry is easy to name. Its sales are shrinking. Over the six months to Monday, November 23, the stock returned -32.9%, counting dividends. The S&P 500 returned -3.2% over the same dates. On Monday alone, Qualcomm rose 10.3.

items.title: Anduril’s Palmer Luckey Thinks “Most AI Is Going to Run Locally.” That’s a Bet on Apple
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnduril founder Palmer Luckey said he expects most AI to run locally on devices, and he’s skeptical of the giant data center build-out. If he’s right, Apple is the clearest winner, since it sells the hardware local AI would run on.
